title: Maple Roasted Tofu with Custard Crème Brûlée
description: A Canadian-inspired dessert featuring roasted tofu and caramelized custard.
instructions: Drain and press the tofu to remove excess liquid.
Wrap the tofu in foil and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine custard, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Pour the mixture into ramekins and top with sugar.
Place the ramekins in a baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the custard is set.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under a broiler.
Serve the roasted tofu with a scoop of caramelized custard crème brûlée.
